reviews.author: Because he’s a genius
reviews.text:
If you wander around the alleys of Euljiro three times, you will want to come here.
The sign is hung as if to hide, and the interior of the house is fueled by beer instead of graffiti.
The project of brewing a new beer a month is not only a plausible concept, but also has a clear character that is sincere about beer.

This month’s ‘Takbok (8,900/330)’ is, as its name suggests, a wheat beer with a peach texture.
Rather than focusing on the soft flesh, the focus is on the elasticity and flavor of the skin.

The nuances of cloves, bananas, and coriander seeds that are common in wheat almost disappear to the background, and the sweetness of peach tea, white flowers, and white grapes comes to the fore.
In the mouth, the carbonation is dense and the sweetness is cut short and disappears, so the advantage is that it does not feel soggy due to the juice.
It just shows what ‘easy drinking’ is (probably) emphasized by this restaurant.

‘Gulp (6,900/330)’ is a lager position.
The advantage is transparency.
It goes on cleanly and tangy without any aftertaste.

However, if you expect Craft's unique personality, it may feel boring.
‘Lucky Cass’ in a good sense—it’s perfect for quenching thirst, but in many ways, it has few memorable points.

‘Smim (7,500/330)’ has the best craft-like look among the three.
On the nose, there is a slight overlap of subtle acidity and herbs, and the bitterness of hops is understated compared to the alcohol content.
It is not a harsh acid like vinegar, but has a refreshing texture like a drop of lime zest.
The texture is not thin throughout the drink, so the balance is maintained until the glass is empty.

To solidify the overall opinion, this house does not twist the recipe in a difficult way, but ends up with a ‘taste that is easy to drink’.
Takbok was designed to have a dense fruity flavor, while Smim created balance by lightly adding acidity and hops.
It's great as a first drink on a day when you're feeling well, but hold on to it on days when you don't feel like eating.
Since it is not a house where snacks are the main character, satisfaction will likely be high if used as a secondary or zero part of the movement route.

reviews.author: YJ Oh
reviews.text: Beer Pub where you can taste beer produced directly from a brewery located in Goyang City. It operates on the 3rd floor of the Daelim Shopping Center building in Euljiro, but there was no sign outside, so it was a bit difficult to find. There are 7 to 8 tables and a bar table in the small interior, and simple tables are also available outdoors. The brewery was established in 2020 and has been making a variety of beers, and is said to have won several awards at domestic and Asian beer competitions. 'Queu' is an onomatopoeia and is said to have various meanings, such as 喫, meaning to eat or drink in Chinese characters, and Geek, meaning eccentric in English. Anyway, the business name is unique and easy to remember. They sell a wide variety of self-produced beers as draft or bottled beers, and I think most of the beers are excellent because they have excellent taste and depth. There are no snacks that can replace a meal, and most snacks are small and simple. The staff said it was okay to bring in food from outside. I am glad to hear that they are working on a project to release a new beer every month starting from mid-2021. It's a nice little place with great beer.

reviews.author: Grilled Garlic Skewers
reviews.text:
Visit to Of Coffee
Of course, I went in thinking it would be on the first floor, but ended up visiting the wrong place. When I came out again and took the elevator up, Of Coffee was on the 8th floor. When you open the door and enter, you find a coffee shop that is smaller than you think.

The space has a white exposure concept. There is white molding and a bright floor, seats are arranged in a row along the window and bar, and the tables are a dark wood tone. The desk support by the window is especially impressive, as it is made of stacked bricks. Rather than an artificially decorated feel, the rough texture matches well with the space. Overall, it has a subtle grassy scent, which suits my personal taste well. Looking at the menu and the space for preparing ingredients, it looks like they also serve alcohol, so it appears to be a space that functions as both a cafe and a bar.

The menu I drank that day was the Rite of Spring. It is served in a pink ceramic-like glass. Since it is a blend rather than a single origin, I ordered it expecting a harmony of various elements rather than neatness.

The overall scent is more savory first, with a slightly acidic scent rising at the end. Since I have rhinitis, I can't tell the difference in detail, but the acidic scent was so weak that at first I thought I had ordered the wrong coffee. Since I am a firm acid fan, I felt more sensitive to this part.

If you take a small sip, the surprisingly strong acidity comes in first. Soon, a thick body comes in, and the acidity comes in first like a light cola-colored wave and wets the floor, followed by heavy coffee with a dark body, taking its place. The acidity becomes more evident when it cools down after some time than when it is hot.

If you drink it by taking a sip in your mouth, the acidity will spread throughout your mouth. After a storm of acidity passes, the lingering scent of bitter coffee remains, but even then, the acidity does not disappear completely and continues in a thin layer. It gives the impression that unripe coffee was roasted very delicately and carefully. It's sour but soft, bitter but fresh. Elements that seem to be opposites coexist in a strange way.

However, the more it cools, the stronger the acidity becomes. The middle taste almost disappears, and it feels like the acidity dominates from the beginning to the middle. The taste that remains at the end is close to the taste of water, but it doesn't leave a very clean impression. This part feels like a unique impression given by the blend.

Overall, it is a coffee dominated by acidity. However, there is a feeling that the body and roasting were used to control the acidity so that it does not become excessive. It's an interesting coffee to drink if it's sour, but it's best to drink it all before it cools down completely. This type of coffee is best finished while it is still warm, rather than slowly cooling and savoring it.

reviews.text:
This park is located on the site of the former Mukjeong Swimming Pool. To the east of Jongang Madang is a children's playground, and to the west is a garden. It's really a small park in the city center.

The central building has public restrooms open 24 hours a day, separated for men and women. Seoul public Wi-Fi is available for free throughout the park.

The basement of the entire park area is a public parking lot. For first-time visitors, it may be difficult to find the entrance due to the one-way street outside the parking lot. If you look at the map I attached, you can see the exit and entrance locations. Yellow signs indicate one-way traffic.

It has five underground levels, and many people who work nearby use long-term parking. Other than that, many customers of naengmyeon restaurants come during lunchtime or on weekends. Even though the total number of parking spaces is almost 500, there are a lot of cars on weekdays. However, in my experience of long-term parking here for 10 years, I have never been unable to park my car.

Parking fee is 800 won per 10 minutes.
Only card payment is accepted. For payment, there are two parking fee adjustment machines next to the elevator on the first floor. If you eat at a nearby cold noodle restaurant, you will receive a 30-minute free parking ticket. If you insert your free parking ticket into the payment machine, the discount will be applied.

Please note that since it is a public parking lot, discounts are available for the disabled, people with multiple children, compact cars, and low-emission vehicles.

reviews.text:
The birthplace of Admiral Yi Sun-sin. There is also the birthplace of Admiral Yi Sun-sin built in front of Myeongbo Art Hall, but the original site of the birthplace is said to be here. It is located in an alley approximately 200 to 300 meters from Myungbo Art Hall, and the name of the building is Shindo Building.
Even though Chungmugong is a great person, not many people know about this position.
Seo Gyeong-deok, a professor at Sungshin Women's University, installed a sign at the general's birthplace on the 28th. The place where the information board is located is Shindo Building, 31-2, Inhyeon-dong 1-ga, Jung-gu, Seoul.
Professor Seo said, “I thought it was a pity that people respected the general, but not only did they not know that he was born, but there was not even a signboard at his birthplace.”
The information board made of cast copper plate measuring 50cm wide and 60cm tall is engraved in large letters with the words 'Chungmugong Yi Sun-sin's birthplace'.
Below it, an explanation was written, “Through research by many historians, the birthplace of Admiral Yi Sun-sin is estimated to be here, and this information board will be installed on April 28, 2017.”

There is only one person, but why are there two birthplace markers? The sign in front of Myungbo Art Hall was erected by the Seoul Metropolitan Government in 1985. However, it is said that at this time, in order to inform many people of the existence of the marker, it was installed on the main street, not at the actual birth site.

In 2017, more than 30 years later, meaningful people confirmed the location of Shindo Building as the real birthplace of Yi Sun-sin after receiving research from historians and installed a sign. This place is less than a 5-minute walk from Myungbo Art Hall. Please be sure to visit and take a proof photo and upload it.... Thank you 🙏

reviews.text:
Death scene of student activist Kim Gwi-jeong
Death due to strong repression of Baekgoldan

In 1991, when Kang Gyeong-dae, a student at Myongji University, died due to excessive oppression by the Baekgoldan group, he participated in the 3rd pan-national rally to condemn the atrocity of the murder of the late Kang Kyeong-dae and end public security rule.
During the protest, he was driven into a dead-end alley near Jinyang Shopping Mall across from the Daehan Theater, and after being indiscriminately beaten in a barrage of tear grenades, he was suffocated to death.
He was later transported to Inje University's Baekjung Medical Center in Jeo-dong, Jung-gu, but died without regaining consciousness.
The police entered the morgue in the early morning of the 26th to take away the body, but were stopped by the bereaved family of Ms. Kim Gwi-jeong, students at Sungkyunkwan University, and officials from the National National Democratic Bereaved Families Council.

reviews.text:
Gallery Cafe Coso located in Samcheong-dong. If you go inward along Samcheong-ro, you will find the COSO building located in the alley on the left. It is easy to spot because it is a four-story building. This is a complex cultural space that combines a gallery and a cafe, and the exhibitions are said to change every month. Admission to the space is one drink per person.

They sell a variety of coffees and 3-4 types of desserts, and And Union beer is also on sale. If you drink in the cafe space on the first floor, drinks will be served in glasses or mugs. If you wish to use other gallery spaces, all drinks will be served in take-out glasses to protect the artwork. The drinks are not cheap, but considering that you can view the gallery with your purchase, the price is reasonable.

Gallery Cafe Koso consists of a total of 4 floors. There is a cafe on the first floor and an office space on the second floor. All other spaces are used as exhibition galleries. If you go up the stairs on the right, you can go upstairs while looking at the scenery beyond the window on the right.

I ordered an iced Americano and a plain Earl Gray Financier. I remember the coffee was a bit acidic, and overall, both the coffee and dessert were above the basics.

It was nice to be able to spend a leisurely time drinking coffee and appreciating the work in a quiet space. Because it was located inside Samcheong-dong, it was relatively less crowded and had a relaxed atmosphere. However, it also means that accessibility is low, so it may not be easy to visit often. I think that once you visit, it would be nice to stay for a long time and work or read a book.

reviews.author: jangwon choi
reviews.text:
Last week, I went to church in Hongje-dong.
This week, I visited Seoul Baptist Church near Chungmuro Station.
It is a church that I noticed when I came near Chungmuro ​​because it is a pretty old-fashioned building.
It is about a 6-minute walk from Exit 1 of Chungmuro ​​Station.
If you go to the Toegye-ro 4-ga intersection, you can see a pretty church.

Seoul Baptist Church also has a long history, starting as Pildong Church on September 25, 1946.
A church built on July 27, 1954 to commemorate Baptist war chaplains and soldiers who died in the line of duty in Korea.
It was the first church established by the Southern Baptist Convention after the Korean War and served as the mother church of the Korean Baptist denomination.
Sunday services are held at 9 a.m., 11 a.m., and 2 p.m.
The church holds Wednesday services at 7:30 p.m. and Friday prayer services at 8:30 p.m.
The current senior pastor, Pastor Seongbong Kim, appears to have been appointed as the 11th senior pastor in 2021.
The history before Pastor Seongbong Kim is not listed on the website.

Impression 1.
Here, too, before the service, they prepare for the second service at 11 o'clock with organ accompaniment.
This is where a male organist provides accompaniment, and the first organist is in charge of the piano.
The choir is located in a terraced area behind the altar.
It seems that when the Southern Baptist Convention created a church, they made it American-style.
I haven't been to a few churches, but the location and arrangement are impressive.

Impression 2.
The current senior pastor, Pastor Seongbong Kim, is said to have been appointed as the 11th senior pastor in 2021.
There is one assistant pastor and five associate pastors, and because it is a Baptist denomination, there are no elders.
There are 11 Simuan Deacons. Here too, there are many ordained deacons compared to the size of the congregation.
The senior pastor's sermon was free of unnecessary elements, but felt very professional.
I feel like I learned a lot from my father, pastor.

Impression 3.
The second part of the praise group, the Hallelujah choir, consisted of about 20 people.
Here too, the praise was good compared to the number of people, and there seemed to be only one female soloist.
Even though the age group was high, it was beautiful to see them praising their abilities to the best of their ability.

Impression 4.
The senior pastor’s sermon was also impressive.
A well-prepared, well-educated, exemplary pastor.
A sermon with a very refined feel in terms of sermon development, length, and time.
One day, the sermon titled “When Life is Unkind to Me” was impressive.

reviews.author: Hyojin Lim
reviews.text: If you take the spire-like elevator located outside of Seun Shopping Mall and go up to the 9th floor, you can see the panoramic view of the city center within the four main gates of Seoul. It is a different view from Namsan or Lotte Tower. Instead of Seoul, which is full of tall buildings, you can see a closer Seoul with low roofs, tall buildings, Jongmyo Shrine, and mountains. It has a different atmosphere from Namsan, making it a good place to relax while looking at the open sky. There are plenty of benches on the rooftop structure, so it's a good place to sit and rest if you're penniless. However, eating and drinking is prohibited here, so please follow the rules.
